about.title: Design
paragraphs: We work across every scale of the landscape — from the quiet intimacy of a balcony garden to the ambitious sweep of a public park. Each project begins with the same question: how should this space make you feel?

Our practice extends beyond the ground plane. We design furniture, lighting, and objects born from the same principles that shape our landscapes — natural materials, thoughtful proportions, and the conviction that beautiful things should age gracefully.

projects.title: West Lake Apartment Landscape
projects.subtitle: 88 Quang An, Tay Ho, Hanoi
projects.alt: West Lake Quang An Apartment Landscape Design
projects.description: Landscape design project for the high-end West Lake apartment complex located at the prime address of 88 Quang An street, right next to the poetic West Lake. The project aims to create a resort-style living space, a sophisticated intersection between modern architecture and the pristine nature of the Tay Ho area.
projects.challenge: The West Lake riverside area has extremely strict requirements for landscape and ecological planning. The challenge was to optimize the panoramic lake view for all outdoor utility spaces, while establishing a green system capable of withstanding strong lake winds and adapting to the specific microclimate.
projects.solution: The design applies a multi-layered flora system interspersed with infinity miniature lakes to create the illusion of the internal water surface connecting seamlessly with West Lake. The promenades are paved with monolithic natural stones, combined with scenic rest pavilions featuring ecological wooden roofs, providing a luxurious and utterly peaceful living experience.

projects.title: Skylight Atrium Renovation
projects.subtitle: Indoor Microclimate Landscape
projects.description: A skylight atrium renovation project transforming a monotonous light-well into a lush green pocket garden inside the house. The design maximizes natural light to sustain a small tropical ecosystem, creating a relaxing green focal point for the living space.
projects.challenge: Planting in a skylight atrium requires strict control over light penetration, automated irrigation, and underground drainage to ensure the interior floor remains dry, while simultaneously preventing insect breeding in a humid environment.
projects.solution: Implementing a vertical green wall system paired with shade-tolerant and drought-resistant tropical plants. A concealed automated drip irrigation system is installed alongside a sophisticated gravel filtration layer and technical drainage trench, ensuring maximum hygiene and aesthetics.

projects.title: Makeup Store Design
projects.subtitle: Beauty Space Interior
projects.description: Interior design project for a Makeup Store. The space is designed in a modern, sophisticated style with an elegant color palette, optimizing the lighting system to enhance product beauty and provide a professional customer experience.
projects.challenge: Arranging the space to maximize the display area for products while creating comfortable, spacious makeup trial zones with strict requirements for color-accurate lighting (high CRI).
projects.solution: Utilizing a customized multi-directional LED lighting system combined with large mirrors to create a visual effect that expands the space. The display shelves feature a minimalist design with soft curves, celebrating femininity and luxury.

projects.title: Dong Bong Lake Park
projects.subtitle: Dai Mo, Nam Tu Liem, Hanoi
projects.alt: Dong Bong Lake Park Landscape Design
projects.description: Landscape design project for Dong Bong Lake Park in Dai Mo ward, Nam Tu Liem district, Hanoi. The design is profoundly inspired by the image of a flowing 'Silk Ribbon' and soaring 'Bird Wings', symbolizing the intersection between local traditions and the prosperous development of the new urban area.
projects.challenge: The main challenge was to create a large-scale multi-functional green space that not only acts as an ecological regulator for the area but also provides iconic architectural highlights while maintaining harmony with the natural flow of the surrounding landscape.
projects.solution: Our solution utilizes meandering lakeside walking paths resembling soft silk ribbons draped across the space, combined with auxiliary structures featuring arched roofs that mimic spreading bird wings. The green areas are ecologically layered from the water surface to the upland, creating a sustainable natural connection.

projects.title: Villa Rooftop Design
projects.subtitle: ParkCity Urban Area, Hanoi
projects.description: Rooftop landscape design project for a high-end villa in the ParkCity urban area, Ha Dong, Hanoi. The space is optimized to become an ideal relaxing retreat, blending with nature right in the heart of the capital.
projects.challenge: The biggest challenge was designing an elevated garden that meets strict technical requirements for waterproofing and load-bearing capacity, while ensuring aesthetics and luxury that fit the overall architectural style of the ParkCity villa area.
projects.solution: We applied the most advanced green roof technologies, selecting plant systems suitable for the harsh microclimate conditions on the rooftop. This was combined with artistic lighting and natural materials to create a tranquil, private, and premium resort-like space.

projects.title: Cho Sat Landscape Renovation
projects.subtitle: Hai Phong City
projects.alt: Cho Sat Hai Phong Landscape Renovation
projects.description: Landscape design and renovation project for the Cho Sat area in Hai Phong. The project aims to bring a modern, fresh look while preserving the historical and cultural characteristics of the city's long-standing commercial symbol.
projects.challenge: Cho Sat is a historical symbol of Hai Phong. The biggest challenge was reconciling the preservation of traditional values with the modern, green, and citizen-friendly upgrade of the landscape infrastructure.
projects.solution: The design proposal focuses on creating seamless open spaces, adding urban greenery, and incorporating local materials. The design also emphasizes community gathering spaces and night landscape lighting.

projects.title: Mau A New Urban Area
projects.subtitle: Urban Landscape Planning & Design
projects.alt: Mau A Yen Bai Urban Landscape
projects.description: Mau A New Urban Area is a project creating a modern and synchronized urban space in Van Yen District, Yen Bai Province. The project features diverse landscape zones including: a central plaza with a majestic European-style centaur statue, an art fountain, a colorful children's playground, and peaceful green walking spaces under vine pergolas. The landscape design scope includes: CX1 (4357.69 m2), CX2 (2681.95 m2), CX3 - Iconic Gate (207.58 m2), CX4 (1287.75 m2), CX1-01 (166.05 m2), and CX1-02 (78.99 m2), creating an ideal and high-class living ecosystem.

projects.title: Aqua Horizon Resort
projects.subtitle: Luxury Coastal Integration
projects.description: A coastal resort landscape where pool, terrace, and planting are composed to align with horizon views and reduce erosion impacts.

projects.title: Nghia Hiep Hung Yen Residential Quarter
projects.subtitle: High-End Residential Landscape Masterplan
projects.alt: Classical fountain plaza in Nghia Hiep Hung Yen residential area
projects.description: A premium residential landscape concept for Nghia Hiep, Hung Yen, centered on a classical fountain plaza, axial walkways, and layered planting. The design combines ceremonial architecture, warm night lighting, and human-scale seating to create an elegant neighborhood destination for gathering, strolling, and relaxation.

projects.title: Luminous Mind
projects.subtitle: Resin Sculpture & Purple LED
projects.description: A sculptural table lamp cast from resin — a glowing brain cradled in an outstretched hand. Lit with a deep purple LED, it dissolves the line between art object and functional light.

projects.title: Contour Glow
projects.subtitle: 3D-printed Wave Cylinder
projects.description: A compact cylinder lamp with undulating 3D-printed ridges that ripple like terrain contours. The translucent shell diffuses warm light into a soft, sculptural glow.

projects.title: Woven Glow I
projects.subtitle: Textile Weave & Wood Base
projects.description: A cylindrical lamp body wrapped in hand-woven textile, set on a solid wood base. The fine mesh weave scatters light evenly, creating a calm amber warmth for any workspace.

projects.title: The Gentleman — Day
projects.subtitle: Paper-cut Silhouette Lamp
projects.description: A skull gentleman in a top hat, hand-drawn and hand-cut into a paper lampshade. Photographed in morning light, the silhouette shows the precision of every cut line against a warm amber ground.

projects.title: Bloom Lantern
projects.subtitle: Hand-cut Daisy Paper Shade
projects.description: A floor lamp shade crafted from natural textured paper with a hand-cut daisy silhouette. At night, city bokeh frames the warm amber glow — a quiet dialogue between craft and the urban landscape.

projects.title: The Gentleman — Night
projects.subtitle: Paper-cut Silhouette Lamp
projects.description: The same skull gentleman lamp photographed at night. Backlit against the city skyline, the hand-cut figure emerges in dramatic fiery amber — a character brought alive by light.

projects.title: Woven Glow II
projects.subtitle: Textile Cylinder & Monster Scene
projects.description: The woven cylinder lamp captured in a playful scene alongside miniature monsters. A reminder that handmade objects carry personality — they become part of the stories in the spaces they inhabit.

projects.title: Lotus Lantern
projects.subtitle: Hand-cut Lotus Paper Shade
projects.description: A close-up of a paper lampshade intricately hand-cut with full lotus blossoms in bloom. The warm backlight transforms each petal into a luminous painting against the dark night.

projects.title: Ringed Glow
projects.subtitle: Layered Ring Cylinder Lamp
projects.description: A minimalist table lamp built from stacked horizontal rings, emitting a clean, even glow. Simple in form but rich in material texture — it finds its place in any quiet corner.

projects.title: Traditional Restaurant Design
projects.subtitle: Architecture & Interior
projects.description: A restaurant design project blending traditional and rustic styles. The facade impresses with a wooden slatted gate, yin-yang tiled roof, and modern dark grey steel structures. The interior space is cozy, featuring natural live-edge wooden furniture, woven bamboo pendant lights, and a stunning floral relief wall art. Wooden louvred windows open up to lush greenery, creating a relaxing dining experience.
